proposals.evidence: Turner gives Hindi/Marathi tū and Assamese tui among nominative reflexes of tuvam. The source-spaced t ū represents the same single pronoun, not a compound; Tharu tūī is compared to the documented emphatic tui type. Source transcription is preserved.
